issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently changes path semantics without a stated precondition on `from` or a unit test
issues.detail: The one-line fix in DecodedMap changes resolve(s, from) to resolve(from, '..', s). The intent — resolve sources relative to dirname(from) per the source-map spec — is correct, but the change silently assumes `from` is always a file path. If `from` is a directory, a URL, or a virtual Vite id, `..` walks one level too high or behaves wrongly. The new postcondition of resolvedSources is nowhere documented and is only validated by a snapshot four layers up the stack. Add a JSDoc invariant and a direct unit test pinning behavior for relative, absolute, URL-like, and empty source entries.

issues.description: getSourceMap performs unbounded synchronous readFileSync on every external stack frame with no memoization
issues.detail: getSourceMap is invoked per frame during parseErrorStacktrace, and for each external file it does existsSync + readFileSync of the entire file, then a full-file regex scan via convert-source-map (which may then readFileSync a sibling .map). With no cache, a deep stack across the same external module re-reads and re-parses the same bytes O(N) times on the reporter hot path. Add a Map<absolutePath, SourceMap|undefined> memoization scoped to the run (or at least the error), and replace existsSync+readFileSync with a try/catch on the read to remove the TOCTOU double-stat.

issues.description: getSourceMap contract is unspecified — return type, error semantics, and failure-mode disjunction are implicit
issues.detail: The new getSourceMap hook has no documented contract for what to return for inlined modules, external modules with no map, external modules with broken/unreadable maps, or modules with missing sourcesContent. The readFileSync and convertSourceMap.fromSource calls are not wrapped in try/catch, so a malformed inline sourcemap comment or a binary file that passes existsSync will throw out of the stack-trace formatter — the worst possible place to throw. Total the function: wrap in try/catch, return undefined on any failure, and write down the precondition/postcondition on the option type so future hook implementations (coverage, browser mode, workers) substitute correctly.

issues.description: Snapshot is the only correctness witness — no unit tests pin the behavior at the unit boundaries
issues.detail: The only evidence the fix works is an updated stacktraces.test.ts.snap showing .ts line numbers instead of .js. Snapshots verify the current end-to-end string; they do not document the contract. Add unit tests at the DecodedMap.resolvedSources boundary (fixtures: relative s, absolute s, URL-like from, missing sources) and at extractSourcemapFromFile (inline map, external .map, missing .map, malformed comment) so the value semantics are durable and the next regression is caught without anyone reading a stack trace.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns the literal string '{}' as a sentinel for missing map files
issues.detail: When the referenced .map file is absent, the helper returns the string '{}' so convert-source-map parses an empty object rather than throwing. This conflates 'no map' with 'broken map' and laundering absence through a fake parseable value hides the case from callers and logs. Either return '' (or undefined) and handle the absence explicitly at the caller, or — at minimum — replace the vague 'fallback to empty source map to avoid errors' comment with a literate statement of the invariant convert-source-map relies on. Consider a debug log so misconfigured builds produce a diagnostic instead of a silently-unmapped stack.

issues.description: moduleGraph.getModuleById(file) assumes the stack-frame path equals a Vite module id
issues.detail: parseErrorStacktrace hands getSourceMap whatever string appears in the frame's file position; Vite's moduleGraph keys modules by id, which is not necessarily the same string (Windows leading-slash differences, querystrings, virtual ids, file URLs). When the lookup misses for reasons unrelated to externalness, the code falls through to existsSync(file) and may read and apply a source map for an inlined module. Extract a named predicate isExternalModule(file) with a stated contract, and tighten the hedge in the inline comment ('should be empty for external modules') so a future change populating transformResult on externalized modules doesn't silently break this branch.

issues.description: Source-map extraction helpers live in test-run.ts instead of the source-map module
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile and createConvertSourceMapReadMap are general-purpose, stateless 'bytes + path -> SourceMap | undefined' transformations that have nothing to do with TestRun's responsibility. Their natural home is packages/utils/src/source-map.ts alongside DecodedMap and parseErrorStacktrace, with test-run.ts holding only the thin shell that decides 'is this module external?' This separation makes the pure core trivially testable without booting Vitest and prevents future callers (coverage reporter, browser-mode reporter) from duplicating the logic or reaching into test-run.ts.

issues.description: convert-source-map added as a dependency for ~30 lines of logic already covered by existing tooling
issues.detail: convert-source-map and its @types are added as runtime+types dependencies to provide fromSource and fromMapFileSource — essentially a regex for the trailing //# sourceMappingURL comment plus base64 decoding. The package already depends on @jridgewell/trace-mapping, and a 30-line local helper (modeled on the Vite implementation referenced in the diff comment) would cover both uses without expanding the dependency surface. Worth confirming the trade-off before shipping.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the patch fixes a real bug — external module stack frames bypassed Vite's transform pipeline and weren't being source-mapped — and the direction is correct. The unanimous P1 concerns are: (1) the load-bearing resolve(from, '..', s) change in DecodedMap silently alters path semantics with an unstated precondition on `from` and no direct unit test, and (2) the new getSourceMap callback does unbounded synchronous readFileSync on every external stack frame with no memoization, on the reporter hot path. A majority also flags that the getSourceMap hook has no specified contract for its failure modes and lacks try/catch, so a malformed map will throw out of the stack-trace formatter. Recurring P2 themes: the '{}' string sentinel conflates absence with corruption, snapshot-only verification doesn't pin the unit-boundary contracts, the moduleGraph.getModuleById heuristic is a leaky proxy for 'external', and the extraction helpers belong next to DecodedMap rather than in test-run.ts. Land after: writing down the DecodedMap and getSourceMap contracts, adding direct unit tests for both boundaries, memoizing the per-file extracted map, and totaling the hook with try/catch.
